app.name: Wazeo
landing.hero.title: Grow faster with Wazeo
landing.hero.subtitle: A fast, affordable SMM panel for Instagram, TikTok and YouTube. Instant orders, drip-feed scheduling, and 24/7 support.
features.drip.title: Drip-feed
features.drip.desc: Spread delivery over hours with smart curves. Natural growth, no suspicious spikes.
features.fast.title: Fast start
features.fast.desc: Most orders start within minutes. Real-time status and order tracking.
features.support.title: 24/7 support
features.support.desc: Ticket system with real staff. Help whenever you need it.
how.step1.d: Sign up with your email in 30 seconds.
how.step2.d: Send a payment and upload your proof.
how.step3.d: Paste a link, choose a service, and go.
faq.a1: Most orders start within minutes. Delivery time depends on the service and the provider.
faq.a2: No. Retention depends on the platform and the target account.
faq.a3: It spreads your order over a set duration using natural growth curves.
